automation.notes:
Roll Options Dialog: on Bot Mode melee attacks, a switch ignores armor bonuses up to your Smarts. Use button: turn on Multiple (2) Targets, which adds ↓1 to those attacks. Automatic: a Bot Mode melee Critical Success knocks the target Prone. Chat card: a Reroll button for Skill Die 1s, which only works on a melee attack made in Bot Mode.

Left to the table: paying the Free action for each benefit, and shoving instead of tripping on a Critical Success.

system.prerequisite: Finesse or Might d6 and Specialization in blades
